module.kubernetes-addons.module.aws_opentelemetry_collector:resource.kubernetes_deployment.aws_otel_eks_sidecar sets metadata.namespace from the local string local.default_addon_config["namespace"] instead of referencing kubernetes_namespace.aws_otel_eks, so there is no ordering between them and the deployment is applied before the namespace exists on a fresh cluster. Add an explicit dependency (or reference the namespace resource) so the deployment is created after the namespace.
